subject: EOQ check: Redwood + StellarApps — timing & approval?
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ check: Redwood + StellarApps — timing & approval?

Hi Sam —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so the team is aligned and we have clear next steps: 

- Goal: Reduce per-query latency for in-product search while cutting inference cost by ~30% through batching + quantized model variants.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for user-facing queries, cost/unit <= $0.004/token equivalent.
- Timeline: StellarApps mentioned wanting to pilot by EOQ (target start 2–3 weeks). Procurement window expected to close early July.
- Constraints: Data residency for EU customers not in scope for pilot; procurement requires SOC2 docs and an internal SOW.

Next steps we agreed on: 
1) I share a draft SOW & pilot plan (attached).
2) You confirm procurement contacts and preferred PO/contract flow.
3) We schedule a 30-min kickoff once procurement gives a green light.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (pilot scope + pricing options).

Can you confirm if the procurement timeline / budget approval is still on track for early July? If anything shifted on your side (priority/budget), let me know and we can adjust the pilot scope.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147
